401.message: [401] The Library no longer accepts this connection. Reconnect it.

403.message: [403] This connection was not given that access. Reconnect and choose the albums or permissions it needs.

404.message: [404] Not found, or not shared with this connection.

409.message: [409] Album access is changing. Retry with the same Source ID.

410.message: [410] The event position expired or this connection's access changed.

429.message: [429] The Library asked Make to slow down.
